gap: No result ChatGPT got says that on the US EcoFlow STREAM Ultra, adding more units adds storage but not grid output. Two to six stacked Ultras (1.92 to 11.52 kWh) still feed the home at a maximum of 1,200 W, the same as one Ultra with one STREAM Microinverter. EcoFlow also says DELTA-series batteries cannot yet be used with the STREAM Ultra.
standout_why: I compared against balconysolarkits.us/kits (cited), solutionenergy.com/solar/balcony/with-battery (cited) and the ChatGPT answer. balconysolarkits.us gives '800 W to the home alone; 1,200 W with the STREAM Microinverter' but says nothing about stacking. solutionenergy.com says the system 'stacks to 11.52 kWh' and gives '1,200 W paired with the STREAM Microinverter', but never says extra Ultras leave grid output at 1,200 W. Neither page says DELTA batteries don't work with it, and neither names a compatible smart meter. I could not open wattbalcon.fr (TLS certificate error) or us.zendure.com (HTTP 429), so I could not check those two.
decides: This confirms the pick rather than changing it. The STREAM Ultra is the only US grid-tied kit with a built-in battery, and it is limited to certain states. A shopper who already owns a DELTA power station cannot add it as storage, and buying more Ultras only adds capacity, never more than 1,200 W of grid output. A shopper outside Utah should still be pointed to a portable power station kit, such as the Anker SOLIX C1000 Gen 2 or a BLUETTI AC180 kit. Those power appliances directly and do not feed the home.

findings.label: Maximum grid output by configuration
findings.value: 800 W for one Ultra alone; 1,200 W for one Ultra plus one STREAM Microinverter; 1,200 W for 2 to 6 Ultra units, with or without a Microinverter
findings.source_title: EcoFlow STREAM Series Plug-and-Play Home Solar System
findings.note: From EcoFlow's US page and footnote 1. The EU page (eu.ecoflow.com/products/stream-ultra-pro, which I saw only in search results and did not open) gives 2,300 W for two units, so the US cap is lower.

findings.label: Storage expansion method and limit
findings.value: Expands from 1.92 kWh to 11.52 kWh by plugging more STREAM Ultra units into AC outlets; the US page does not mention the STREAM AC Pro
findings.source_title: EcoFlow STREAM Series Plug-and-Play Home Solar System
findings.note: 11.52 / 1.92 = 6 units. That matches the '2–6 units' configuration on the same page.

findings.label: DELTA-series battery compatibility
findings.value: Not supported yet; EcoFlow says 'The compatibility of DELTA Series batteries and STREAM Ultra will be available soon.'
findings.source_title: EcoFlow STREAM Series Plug-and-Play Home Solar System
findings.note: Quoted from EcoFlow's US page. This means owners of an existing DELTA power station cannot use it as STREAM storage today.

findings.label: Recommended smart meter
findings.value: Shelly Pro 3EM, set up for single-phase operation if net metering isn't supported
findings.source_title: EcoFlow STREAM Series Plug-and-Play Home Solar System
findings.note: EcoFlow 'recommend[s] pairing the system with the Shelly Pro 3EM'. A search snippet also listed the EcoFlow Smart Meter, Shelly 3EM and Tibber Pulse IR, but I did not open that page, so they are left out.

findings.label: Outage outlet output and appliance limit
findings.value: Two AC outlets give up to 800 W from one unit, or 1,200 W with the Microinverter; plugged-in appliances must have a surge below 1,200 W
findings.source_title: EcoFlow STREAM Series Plug-and-Play Home Solar System
findings.note: EcoFlow says heavy loads such as AC units, microwaves and hair dryers must run on household circuits while the grid is up.

findings.label: Region where sale and plug-in installation are allowed
findings.value: Utah only (footnote 6: 'only available for sale and plug-and-play installation in Utah')
findings.source_title: EcoFlow STREAM Series Plug-and-Play Home Solar System
findings.note: Rival pages disagree. solutionenergy.com says Utah, Maryland and Colorado. A search snippet of us.ecoflow.com/products/stream-ultra said Utah, Maryland, Connecticut and Colorado, but that page returned HTTP 429, so I could not check it.

findings.label: Certifications
findings.value: UL 1741 and IEEE 1547; the page names neither UL 9540 nor UL 3700
findings.source_title: EcoFlow STREAM Series Plug-and-Play Home Solar System
findings.note: Only the certifications printed on the page.
